## Sunni Audit Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed `artifacts/audit_report.md` from the latest dry-run.
- [ ] All decisive religious claims use the required evidence format:
  `QURAN: S:V`
  `TAFSIR: author | work | vol/page or id | edition or stable URL`
  `HADITH: collection | book/chapter | hadith # | grading=... | grader=... | source=...`
  `FIQH: madhhab | manual | vol/page | quote summary`
- [ ] Reviewer sign-off completed.
- [ ] Scholar sign-off completed for changes under religious-content paths.
- [ ] No Qur'anic ayah text was edited by automation.
- [ ] Any open khilaf issue is presented fairly or routed for scholar review.
